北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京小雨连连，体感闷热，出门记得带伞，小心湿滑哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing has light rain and feels muggy. Take an umbrella and watch your step!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪小雨伴大风，体感较凉，外出添衣，注意防风防雨。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has light rain and strong winds. Dress warmly and stay dry!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天风大，体感舒适，出门注意添衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy with strong winds. Wear an extra layer and enjoy!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴热，体感近 40℃，注意防晒补水，小心中暑哦！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is scorching hot, feels like 39℃. Hydrate and avoid sunstroke!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗炎热，体感 34℃，多饮水，注意防晒。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and hot, feels like 34℃. Stay hydrated and use sunscreen!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨伴 7级大风，体感湿凉，出门注意防风防雨。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain and strong winds. Bring an umbrella and dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天多风，气温较高，出行注意防晒，小心大风。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy and windy with high temperatures. Watch out for strong winds!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴热，体感 35℃，请注意防暑降温，多喝水。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy and hot, feels like 35℃. Stay cool and drink plenty of water!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉晴朗酷热，体感 37℃，一定要注意防暑降温哦！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is scorching hot at 37℃. Please stay cool and prevent heatstroke!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天炎热，体感 34℃，多补水，注意防暑。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy and hot, feels like 34℃. Hydrate and prevent heatstroke!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆晴朗酷热，体感 39℃，户外活动请务必防晒防暑！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is extremely hot at 39℃. Take extreme care to prevent heatstroke outdoors!

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨多云，体感舒适，湿度较高，出门带伞有备无患。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is cloudy and comfortable, with high humidity. An umbrella might be handy!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳大雨倾盆，湿度 99%，出门记得带伞，小心路滑！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang has heavy rain and high humidity. Take an umbrella and watch your step!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，体感舒适凉爽，出门注意添衣哦。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and pleasantly cool. Remember to add a layer!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天风大，气温较高，外出注意防晒防风。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy and windy with high temperatures. Watch out for strong winds!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，能见度低，湿度大。出行请注意交通安全。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy and humid. Drive safely and watch for low visibility!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连阴天伴 6级大风，体感凉爽，出门注意防风添衣。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy with strong winds, feels cool. Dress warmly and beware of wind!
